purpose: Frozen body-segment inertial authority (de Leva-adjusted Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov), geometry, foot partition and reproducibility rules.

decisions.value: de Leva (1996) adjustment of Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov parameters, joint-center referenced
decisions.notes: Machine-readable coefficients in AUTHORITY_INPUTS.json; no uniform-density torso shortcut may be called anthropometric authority.

decisions.statement: Male segment mass fractions (head 0.0694; upper trunk 0.1596; middle trunk 0.1633; pelvis/lower trunk 0.1117; upper arm 0.0271 each; forearm 0.0162 each; hand 0.0061 each; thigh 0.1416 each; shank 0.0433 each; whole foot 0.0137 each).
decisions.notes: Fractions sum to 1.0000 across all segments.

decisions.statement: Segment masses at the reference athlete mass.

decisions.locator: sum of body segments; plus bar mass
decisions.notes: Machine test: athlete total = 79.0 kg and system total = 99.0 kg within numerical tolerance.

decisions.locator: frozen stature ratio 0.2425 * H; de Leva Table 4 male thigh (HJC-KJC) 422.2 mm x stature scale as cross-check
decisions.notes: Normative 0.2425 * H = 0.4449875 m; de Leva-scaled cross-check 0.444995405 m (delta 7.90493969e-06 m).

decisions.locator: frozen stature ratio 0.2493 * H; de Leva Table 4 male shank (KJC-LMAL) 434.0 mm x stature scale as cross-check
decisions.notes: Normative 0.2493 * H = 0.4574655 m; de Leva-scaled cross-check 0.45743251 m (delta -3.29899483e-05 m).

decisions.statement: HAT component segment lengths (head VERT-CERV; upper trunk CERV-XYPH; middle trunk XYPH-OMPH).
decisions.locator: S01 Table 4 male alternative-endpoint rows x stature scale
decisions.notes: Stature scaling rule: lengths scale linearly with H / 1.741 m.

decisions.locator: S01 Table 4 male lower trunk OMPH-MIDH
decisions.notes: The pelvis body carries the de Leva lower-trunk (LPT) parameters; MIDH is the trunk-pelvis hinge center.

decisions.locator: S03 D-C foot length 0.152H = 0.279 m at H; S20/S21 elite and adolescent soccer feet
decisions.sensitivity: foot geometry sensitivity: FOOT_LENGTH +/- 0.010 m; FOOT_WIDTH +/- 0.007 m
decisions.notes: 0.275 x 0.105 m is a literature-informed synthetic nominal, not one-paper direct.

decisions.statement: Ankle joint center height above the sole.
decisions.notes: Used for standing geometry and contact placement.

decisions.statement: Ankle joint center horizontal position from the heel.
decisions.locator: no joint-center-resolved public value located; 0.20 * foot length
decisions.notes: Explicit engineering reduction; must not be presented as measured anatomy.

value.sagittal: about the model medio-lateral axis (sagittal-plane rotation)
value.transverse: about the in-plane axis perpendicular to the segment long axis

decisions.locator: S01 Table 4 column semantics (sagittal / transverse / longitudinal r)
decisions.sensitivity: segment-inertia sensitivity 0.9x/1.1x on all segment inertia terms
decisions.notes: Axis-to-model mapping is an engineering reduction of the published axes; it is applied identically to every segment.

decisions.statement: Segment-chain closure check against reference stature.
decisions.locator: ankle height + shank + thigh + (MIDH to vertex chain)
decisions.notes: The joint-center-resolved chain overshoots stature by ~3.1 cm (~1.7%); the causes are mixed landmark systems between sources. RES-83 must absorb this in the standing pose and must not rescale the frozen segment lengths to force closure.

decisions.statement: Lower-limb segment inertias about their own COMs (thigh Ixx=Iyy/Izz; shank Ixx/Iyy/Izz).
decisions.locator: S01 Table 4 radii of gyration * segment lengths
decisions.notes: Body-frame origins: pelvis at MIDH, thigh at HJC, shank at KJC; z is proximal-to-distal.

decisions.statement: Whole-foot de Leva cross-check versus the multi-segment foot construction.
decisions.locator: S01 whole-foot row vs S02 three-segment construction
decisions.sensitivity: foot-inertia sensitivity 0.5x/1.5x (Matsumoto practice) plus the compliant-midfoot alternative
decisions.notes: Cross-check deltas are declared, not hidden; the three-segment construction controls because it is what the Plant implements.

decisions.statement: Stature scaling rule for de Leva component lengths.
decisions.sensitivity: anthropometry sensitivity: stature set [1.835, 1.7764, 1.8936] m and mass set [79, 72.69, 85.31] kg (approximately +/-1 SD of the S05 cohort: 5.86 cm, 6.31 kg)
decisions.notes: Applies to HAT components, pelvis and whole-foot reference length; thigh/shank are frozen by their stature ratios.

decisions.value: any change to a frozen ratio, mass fraction or length is an explicit authority amendment with downstream requalification
